player_outcome: An ordinary empty-field player can manufacture Building Materials, build a vehicle factory/park/training/logistics chain, train a Driver, manufacture/fuel/park a transport truck and send actual newly manufactured ammunition to HQ with a returning truck.
observed_gaps: Training instructor control targets legacy duty training even when empty-field schools have site-specific duties. First instructor purchase exists but is hidden under specialist recovery. Student eligibility excludes only the legacy instructor duty and can take the only instructor from a constructed school into a specialist course, leaving no teacher.
Automatically seeded construction hauls specify receiving only; new M11 is produced at a Materials Plant output store, so expansion can wait despite available manufactured stock.
Vehicle crew/fuel walking and final parking-route validation still use immutable template facilities in the empty-field game. Dispatch rear-worker paths also call the template navigator.

The first complete command-path run physically completed the Materials Plant, then exposed that clicking a newly completed factory resolves against a stale hidden Production selector. Deferred tab refresh occurs too late, so the controller falls back to Inspection instead of that factory's controls. Refresh current Production choices before resolving its stable ID.

ownership.construction: Construction owns which sources an automatically generated site-material haul may use. Record actual Materials Plant output store IDs when a site/plant is created or activated. Existing haul request quantity, cancellation, reservations and carries remain with Rear. Explicit player single-source requests keep their specified source.
ownership.hauling: Rear's existing candidate selection may choose a valid current stock among declared source IDs, with fresh accessibility, stock, route, capacity and atomic claim checks. Existing selected or carried portions keep their captured source/destination. No recurring discovery scan or new scheduler.
ownership.training: Existing purchase/arrival/course owners remain authoritative. UI selects the actual active training-site duty, offers the existing120-requisition instructor purchase visibly and requests actual courses. Student eligibility respects every active instructor duty, so a queued specialist course cannot take its own only teacher. No trained person is granted.
ownership.routes: Use rear.walk_path for rear people, and current construction geometry for empty-field truck validation. Preserve legacy template geometry for legacy sessions, current footprint checks and occupied parking protection.
ownership.logistics: Existing automatic Logistics Centre worker/manifest/departure/HQ receipt/return owners remain; no manual Depart requirement or cargo credit shortcut.

events: Source membership updates only on explicit site/material-order creation and Materials Plant activation. Existing physical committed events wake work. No new Timer, process/physics polling, time_advanced subscription or broad world snapshot is added.
cancellation: Never create a replacement site haul after its owned request/site is cancelled. Source alternatives do not change requested/delivered quantity or erase selected/carried work. Session replacement creates fresh model-owned records; UI selection resolves current school/person/hull IDs.
usability: Expose Training and Vehicles in ordinary primary navigation, with getting-started instructions for the Materials-to-truck chain. Show normal transport-truck steps and links in Vehicles, actual school/instructor controls in Training, separate rear-only crew and fuel-worker choices and actionable missing requirements. Resolve a newly completed factory against fresh Work choices before loading it. When the model/facility identity changes, show that facility's actual worker target even if the previous field retained focus; preserve editing within the same facility. Keep advanced C30 controls distinct; do not alter recipes or input drafts merely on navigation.
verification: Freeze one headless playthrough before code. Use actual normal scene controls/commands, actual purchases and physical construction/manufacture/training/carry/driving/HQ unload/return. Explicit component time may shorten wall-clock waiting; it does not establish native1x/FPS or naturally arising battlefield shortage. Show exact starting-stock/budget and no grants/reset/diagnostic setup of factories or hulls.
unchanged: Approved opening,6000 HQ rifle rounds, prices, recipes, rates, physical source/claim/carry guards, speed controls and performance limits. Manual supply request is a valid player action but cannot close the genuine automatic-army-need goal by itself.
principles: Authoritative state and captured physical work
Context-specific navigation instead of phantom geometry
Actual complete player outcome before stopping
